cells.quote: Self-reported usefulness of participation in YPT -related activities by students show differences contingent on the number of years that students had to complete until their final exam (see 1.2.2). In our regression analysis, we find that students that still had some time until their final exam considered the participation in YPT-related activities as less useful than students who were in their final or last-to-final year.
cells.note: The study reports a linear regression with year of final exam as the baseline; the printed coefficient for one year before the final exam is -0.476 for ability to locate and use information.
